prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Relocate Sign-In After Companion Assembly Waiting: Move the sign_in step to occur after the waiting step so users register their account only after pet assembly finishes. (why: Sign-in drops 22.6% of starting users; placing registration after asset creation builds commitment before requiring credentials.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Multi-Step Pet Personality & Aesthetic Builder Flow: Introduce a interactive multi-option carousel flow on the pick_friend screen for selecting pet color palette and temperament traits. (why: Adoption stage drops 26.3% of users and takes an average of 1017s due to complex custom pet options.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Account Data Preservation & Re-Login Reassurance Banner: Display explicit security and pet persistence reassurance text on the sign_in card. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
3: [home, wait_info] Pre-Launch Desktop Overlay Compatibility Checklist: Show an active system compatibility checklist component during the waiting screen to verify screen permissions and overlay window settings. (why: 3 support emails reported that pets fail to appear on desktop or the app stutters at launch.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Story Intro Companion Path Overview Tip: Add an explanatory badge and guide hint to the story screen highlighting how path choices influence pet behavior. (why: The choose_path mean time of 514s indicates users spend considerable time unsure about path differences.)
5: [home, incentive] Interactive Audio Toy Playground During Download: Embed a sound button and toy preview animation on the waiting screen so users can interact with companion sounds while assets build. (why: The home waiting step takes a mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs during asset loading.)
6: [finish, hint] Desktop Companion Shortcut Keys Visual Summary: Display explicit keyboard shortcut hints and tray location instructions on the home_intro screen. (why: Support received multiple messages regarding confusion on how to control or minimize the companion after onboarding.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in after pet assembly leverages user investment, targeting a 22.6% drop.
Adoption has high drop-off (26.3%) and 1017s mean time; structured flow eases setup.
Strong support email signal (8 tickets); simple copy change reassures returning users.
Home step conversion is already high (93.5%), so potential recovery is limited.
High mean time (514s) points to user hesitation on path choice; visual tips reduce hesitation.
Home wait time is extremely long (2336s), but home drop-off rate is relatively low.
Finish step loses 29.1% of users and support reports post-onboarding confusion.
